"''I'm ''talking'' to you!|The stormtrooper trying to get an answer out of NED-B|}} A '''stormtrooper''' was active on the [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]] during [[9 BBY]].[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] is set ten [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' must be set in [[9 BBY]]. As part of the reinvigorated [[Hunt for Obi-Wan Kenobi|hunt]] for the [[Jedi]] fugitive [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], he was paired with [[Unidentified stormtrooper 2 (Mapuzo safehouse)|another trooper]] to check buildings, which happened to include the safehouse used by [[Tala Durith]]. The trooper tried to accost the resident [[loader droid]], [[NED-B]], because he was mute and couldn't answer his questions. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The [[stormtrooper]] appeared in "[[Part III]]" the third episode of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']]. ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part III}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 3|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 3]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Stormtrooper non-identifié 1 (Refuge de Mapuzo) |ka=უცნობი შტურმტრუპერი 1 (მაპუზოს თავშესაფარი) |tr=Tanımlanamayan stormtrooper 1 (Mapuzo güvenli evi) }} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
